# James Romm

Photo of James Romm

Photo: © Doug Baz

**James Romm** is the James H. Ottaway Jr. Professor of Classics at Bard College and author of several books, including _Dying Every Day: Seneca at the Court of Nero_ and _Ghost on the Throne: The Death of Alexander the Great and the War for Crown and Empire_ . He has edited numerous translations of ancient Greek texts, including the _Anabasis_ of Arrian for the volume _The Campaigns of Alexander_ in the distinguished Landmark Series of Ancient Historians.
